reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her direct message: on Oct 14 she told me Bay 30 is her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. That's what the note I saved for her says.

The memory index now has a second entry I didn't write, a private note that Hollis Mbeki uses Dock 14 for Marrow Fieldworks pickups. It has nothing to do with Ilse, so I didn't open it or mention it to her.
